title: Detroit’s Holiday Food Tour: Donuts, Pastries & Sweet Treats
blurb:
Our holiday journey begins at Astoria Bakery, a local favorite offering a taste of Greektown’s charm with its array of irresistible baked goods. Here we'll try some of Detroit's best donuts, made fresh daily and potentially other holiday treats.

Heading near the Shinola Hotel, enjoy expertly crafted coffee and creative desserts in a neighborhood blending Detroit’s industrial roots with modern flair. In Parker’s Alley, tucked behind the hotel, discover a boutique chocolatier crafting unique holiday themed confections in this revitalized urban gem.

Our next stop is Cannelle, a patisserie inspired by French baking, where exquisite holiday pastries showcase Detroit’s elevated culinary scene. We’ll end at Campus Martius, the vibrant heart of downtown, where the city’s rich history meets its modern energy and a perfect way to enjoy the holidays in downtown Detroit.
